# Major tumor lobe differences

In this section we look to identify the major transcriptional differences between tumor cells in the lower dense lobe and tumor cells in the upper interdigitated lobe of the tumor.

```{r}
#| label: loading preamble
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
source("./preamble.R")
```

## Identify tumor lobes
We first manually define the two main regions of the tumor - the bottom dense, localized lobe as well as the upper interdigitated lobe. 

Manually draw a polygon around the lower localized tumor lobe.
```{r}
#| label: identify_lower_lobe
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false

# if there's no seurat object, read it in
if (!("seu.obj" %in% ls())){
  seu.obj <- readRDS(results_list$seurat_file_postCellTyping)
}

if(is.null(results_list$lower_lobe_cells)){
  
  ## Select outermost ring of cells to consider
  
  # Define a polygon selection function
  euclidean <- function(a, b) {
    sqrt(sum((a - b)^2))
  }
  
  select_polygon <- function(distmin = 0.01, max_points = 40){
    message("Please select points to define a polygon.  Click to the first point to stop.  First point marker is largest.")
    lims <- par("usr")
    margins <- par("plt")
    calcX <- function(x, limitss = lims, mars = margins) limitss[1] + ((x-mars[1])/(1-(1-mars[2])-mars[1]))*(limitss[2]-limitss[1])
    calcY <- function(y, limitss = lims, mars = margins) limitss[3] + ((y-mars[3])/(1-(1-mars[4])-mars[3]))*(limitss[4]-limitss[3])
    calcXY <- function(z) c(calcX(z[1]), calcY(z[2]))
    
    # determine diagonal distance in the plotting coordinate frame
    diagonalDist <- euclidean(lims[c(1,3)], lims[c(2,4)])
    
    # select first and second point and third point
    pg <- matrix(c(0,0), nrow = 1)
    pg[1, ] <- calcXY(unlist(grid::grid.locator(unit = "npc")))
    points(pg[1,1], pg[1,2], cex = 1, pch = 9, col = "magenta")
    pg <- rbind(pg, calcXY(unlist(grid::grid.locator(unit = "npc"))))
    points(pg[nrow(pg),1], pg[nrow(pg),2], cex = 0.5, pch = 9, col = "magenta")
    pg <- rbind(pg, calcXY(unlist(grid::grid.locator(unit = "npc"))))
    points(pg[nrow(pg),1], pg[nrow(pg),2], cex = 0.5, pch = 9, col = "magenta")
    
    #select additional points until a point is within the desired distance of the original point (or hit max_points limit)
    while(euclidean(pg[nrow(pg),], pg[1,]) > distmin*diagonalDist){
      pg <- rbind(pg, calcXY(unlist(grid::grid.locator(unit = "npc"))))
      points(pg[nrow(pg),1], pg[nrow(pg),2], cex = 0.5, pch = 9, col = "magenta")
      if(nrow(pg) > max_points) {
        message("You reached the max allowed points.")
        break
      }
    }
    if(nrow(pg) > 3) pg <- pg[1:(nrow(pg)-1),]
    polygon(pg[,1],pg[,2],col="#00000007",border="red")
    return(pg)
  }
  
  # Plot cells in bottom of tumor
  plot(seu.obj@meta.data$x_slide_mm, 
       seu.obj@meta.data$y_slide_mm, 
       cex = 0.01, ylim = c(-0.5,6), 
       asp=1, col = rgb(0,0,0,0.1))
  
  
  # Select outer tumor edge polygon manually
  pg_outer <- select_polygon()
  
  # which points are within the polygon
  idx_selected <- mgcv::in.out(pg_outer, as.matrix(seu.obj@meta.data[,c("x_slide_mm","y_slide_mm")] ))
  outer_cells <- seu.obj@meta.data$cell_id[idx_selected]
  
  # Add to results list
  results_list$lower_lobe_cells <- outer_cells
  saveRDS(results_list, results_list_file)
}
```


Manually draw a polygon around the upper interdigitated tumor lobe.

## Contrast tumor lobes - cell types

As a next basic step, we show cell type distributions in each lobe.
```{r}
#| label: plot_cell_type_fractions_by_lobe
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false

if (!("seu.obj" %in% ls())){
  seu.obj <- readRDS(results_list$seurat_file_postCellTyping)
}

# Isolate meta for plotting
meta <- seu.obj@meta.data

# Add lobe assignments
meta$lobe <- "none"
meta[results_list$upper_lobe_cells, "lobe"] <- "Upper"
meta[results_list$lower_lobe_cells, "lobe"] <- "Lower"

# Plot cell types by lobe
ggplot(meta[which(meta$lobe != "none"),], 
       aes(x = minor_cell_type)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = minor_cell_type), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = results_list$minor_cell_type_color_pal, name = "Cell Type") +
  xlab("Cell Type") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  ylab("Total cells") +
  facet_wrap(~lobe)
ggsave(filename = paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Plots/Barplot_cellsPerCellType_byLobe.png"),
       width = 16, height = 8, unit = "in")


```


The major tumor type contributing to the top tumor are HPD+ tumor. In contrast, the major tumor type in the bottom tumor are KRT16+ and proliferating tumor.

## Contrast tumor lobes - differential expression

We use differential expression to contrast tumor cells in the two lobes, using only genes that are more likely to be expressed in tumor cells than surrounding cells (ie are unlikely to be present simply due to tumor cells overlapping with non-tumor cells at their borders).

```{r}
#| label: runDE_tumorLobes_tumorGenes
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false

if (!("seu.obj" %in% ls())){
  seu.obj <- readRDS(results_list$seurat_file_postCellTyping)
}

# Isolate meta for plotting
meta <- seu.obj@meta.data

# Add lobe assignments
meta$lobe <- "none"
meta[results_list$upper_lobe_cells, "lobe"] <- "Upper"
meta[results_list$lower_lobe_cells, "lobe"] <- "Lower"

## Run DE between tumor lobes on tumor cells only

# Pre-de find neighbors
pre_de_obj <- pre_de(
  metadata = meta,
  cell_type_metadata_colname = "major_cell_type",
  mm_radius = 0.05,
  sdimx_colname = "x_slide_mm",
  sdimy_colname = "y_slide_mm",
  verbose = TRUE,
  adjacencies_only = TRUE
)

# Add total counts to metadata as DE expects
meta$totalcounts = meta$nCount_RNA

# Use overlap metric to identify genes to test
overlap_metrics <- 
smiDE::overlap_ratio_metric(assay_matrix = seu.obj@assays$RNA$data,
                           metadata = meta,
                           cluster_col = "major_cell_type",
                           radius = 0.05,
                           #split_neighbors_by_colname = "Run_Tissue_name",
                           sdimx_col = "x_slide_mm",
                           sdimy_col = "y_slide_mm"
                           )

# Save overlap metrics
saveRDS(overlap_metrics, file = paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Data/overlap_metrics.rds"))

# Only analyze genes with ratio less than or equal to 1
analysis_genes <- overlap_metrics[major_cell_type=="Tumor" & ratio <= 1]$target

# DE test dependence on tumor lobe
de_obj <- smi_de(
  assay_matrix = seu.obj@assays$RNA@counts[analysis_genes,],
  metadata = meta[which(meta[,"major_cell_type"] == "Tumor"),],
  formula = ~RankNorm(otherct_expr) + lobe + offset(log(totalcounts)),
  pre_de_obj = pre_de_obj,
  groupVar = "lobe",
  neighbor_expr_cell_type_metadata_colname = "major_cell_type",
  neighbor_expr_totalcount_normalize = TRUE,
  neighbor_expr_totalcount_scalefactor = NULL,
  family = "nbinom2",
  targets = analysis_genes,
  nCores = 20
)

# Save objects
saveRDS(pre_de_obj, file = paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Data/pre_de_obj.rds"))
saveRDS(de_obj, file = paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Data/de_obj_tumorGenes.rds"))
```

With the major differences between tumor cells in the two lobes, we first generate a volcano plot to visually demonstrate the vast differences between these two lobes. Also save these results to a table.
```{r}
#| label: plotDE_tumorLobes_tumorGenes
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false

# Read in DE object
de_obj <- readRDS(paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Data/de_obj_tumorGenes.rds"))

# Extract pairwise results, invasive vs localized lobe
pairwise.df <- results(de_obj, "pairwise")$pairwise
pairwise.df <- pairwise.df %>% filter(term == "lobe") %>%
  filter(contrast == "Lower / Upper")

# Convert terminology to Dense / Interdigitated
pairwise.df$contrast <- gsub("Lower / Upper", "Dense / Interdigitated", pairwise.df$contrast)

# Adjust p-value
pairwise.df$p.adj <- p.adjust(pairwise.df$p.value, method = "fdr")

# Save pairwise results to a table to be included as supplementary information.
write.csv(as.data.frame(pairwise.df)[,c(setdiff(colnames(pairwise.df), c("df", "null", "fold_change")))],
          file = paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Data/TumorLobeDE_table.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Plot it, partially following smiDE volcano code
# Ensure that the lower lobe is plotted on the left to align with tissue image

# Extract comparison
cc = pairwise.df$contrast[1]
compv = compv <- strsplit(as.character(cc), "\\ vs.\\ ")[[1]]
if(grepl(" [\\/-]\\ ", cc)) compv <- strsplit(as.character(cc), "\\ [\\/-]\\ ")[[1]]

# x labels
xrng <- pairwise.df[!is.na(log2(fold_change)),c(min(-log2(fold_change)),max(-log2(fold_change)))]
xrng <- c(-max(abs(xrng)), max(abs(xrng)))
xrng <- pretty(xrng)

# Set up y labels
nDigits <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.integer(strsplit(x = formatC(formatC(x = x, format="e"), format = "s"), split = "e")[[1]][2]))
bonf<- pairwise.df[,0.05/(uniqueN(target) * uniqueN(contrast))]
max.y <- nDigits(min(pairwise.df[,min(p.value)+10^-300], signif(bonf / 2, 1)))

ybrk <- 1 * 10^pretty( c(-1:(max.y)) )
ylab <- ybrk

# Add coloring
fc_cutoff = 0.5
pairwise.df$sig_group = paste0("P adj > 0.05\nand/or\nlog2FC < ", fc_cutoff)
pairwise.df$sig_group[intersect(which(pairwise.df$p.adj < 0.05),
                                which(log2(pairwise.df$fold_change) > fc_cutoff))] <- compv[1]
pairwise.df$sig_group[intersect(which(pairwise.df$p.adj < 0.05),
                                which(log2(pairwise.df$fold_change) < -fc_cutoff))] <- compv[2]
my_cols = c("tomato3", "lightskyblue3", "lightgrey")
names(my_cols) = c("Interdigitated",
                   "Dense",
                   paste0("P adj > 0.05\nand/or\nlog2FC < ", fc_cutoff))

ggplot(pairwise.df,
       aes(x = -log2(fold_change), y = p.value + 10^-300)) + # Negative log fold change switches the L/R order of upper / lower
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = fc_cutoff, linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -fc_cutoff, linetype = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig_group), size = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_cols, name = "Significance group") +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = smiDE:::change_axis_revlog_trans(base=10),
                     breaks = ybrk,
                     labels = formatC(ylab, format = "e", digits = 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = xrng, limits = range(xrng)) +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("p value") +
  xlab(paste0(compv[1], " ", sprintf('\u2190'), " log", sprintf('\u2082'), "(FC) ", sprintf('\u2192'), " ", compv[2]) ) + # Compv 1 and 2 are switched in order from usual to account for L/R switch of categories
  geom_text(data = pairwise.df[1,], aes(label = paste0(sum(pairwise.df$sig_group == "Interdigitated"), "\ngenes"), 
                                        x = min(abs(max(xrng)), abs(min(xrng)))*0.75, y = sqrt(min(ybrk))),
            color = my_cols[["Interdigitated"]], size = 8) +
  geom_text(data = pairwise.df[1,], aes(label = paste0(sum(pairwise.df$sig_group == "Dense"), "\ngenes"), 
                                        x = -min(abs(max(xrng)), abs(min(xrng)))*0.75, y = sqrt(min(ybrk))),
            color = my_cols[["Dense"]], size = 8) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))
ggsave(filename = paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Plots/volcano_lobeDifferences_tumorGenes.png"),
       width = 6, height = 4, units = "in")

```

```{r}
knitr::include_graphics(paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Plots/volcano_lobeDifferences_tumorGenes.png"))
```


Next, we show the 20 genes with the largest fold change between these two lobes.

```{r}
#| label: gather_topDEgenes_tumorGenes
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false

# Read in DE object
de_obj <- readRDS(paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Data/de_obj_tumorGenes.rds"))

# Extract pairwise results, invasive vs localized lobe
pairwise.df <- results(de_obj, "pairwise")$pairwise
pairwise.df <- pairwise.df %>% filter(term == "lobe") %>%
  filter(contrast == "Lower / Upper")

# Extract 20 genes with top FC
top_upper <- pairwise.df %>%
  arrange(p.value, -abs(log2(fold_change))) %>%
  filter(fold_change < 1) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  select(target, contrast, fold_change, p.value, modelest_cpc_1, modelest_cpc_2)

top_lower <- pairwise.df %>%
  arrange(p.value, -abs(log2(fold_change))) %>%
  filter(fold_change > 1) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  select(target, contrast, fold_change, p.value, modelest_cpc_1, modelest_cpc_2)

# Add to results
results_list$top_upper_DE_tumGenes <- top_upper
results_list$top_lower_DE_tumGenes <- top_lower
saveRDS(results_list, results_list_file)
```

We use ReactomePA to identify pathways enriched in the set of genes up in the interdigitated lobe and in the localized lobe.

```{r}
#| label: pathways_by_lobe_tumGenes
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false

# Read in DE object
de_obj <- readRDS(paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Data/de_obj_tumorGenes.rds"))

# Extract pairwise results, invasive vs localized lobe
pairwise.df <- results(de_obj, "pairwise")$pairwise
pairwise.df <- pairwise.df %>% filter(term == "lobe") %>%
  filter(contrast == "Lower / Upper")

# Convert terminology to Dense / Interdigitated
pairwise.df$contrast <- gsub("Lower / Upper", "Dense / Interdigitated", pairwise.df$contrast)

# Find pathways enriched in each lobe, working only with those with p.adj < 0.05
# and log2fc > 0.5

# Adjust p-value
pairwise.df$p.adj <- p.adjust(pairwise.df$p.value, method = "fdr")

# Find gene sets
upper_genes <- pairwise.df %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  filter(log2(fold_change) < -0.5) %>%
  select(target)

lower_genes <- pairwise.df %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  filter(log2(fold_change) > 0.5) %>%
  select(target)

pathway_res <- list()
for (i in c("upper_genes", "lower_genes")){
  print(paste0("Top pathways in set ", i, ":"))
  gene_ids <- bitr(get(i)$target, "SYMBOL", "ENTREZID", org.Hs.eg.db)
  enrich_result1 <- enrichPathway(gene = gene_ids$ENTREZID,
                                  organism = "human")
  pathway_res[i] <- enrich_result1
  print(enrich_result1@result[1:10, c("Description", "FoldEnrichment", "qvalue")])
}

# Save pathway results
saveRDS(pathway_res, file = paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Data/pathwayEnrichmentResults_tumorGenes.rds"))

# Also save top pathways to results file
results_list$top_upper_pathways_tumGenes <- pathway_res[["upper_genes"]]@result %>%
  filter(qvalue < 0.05) %>%
  select("Description", "FoldEnrichment", "qvalue")
results_list$top_lower_pathways_tumGenes <- pathway_res[["lower_genes"]]@result %>%
  filter(qvalue < 0.05) %>%
  select("Description", "FoldEnrichment", "qvalue")
saveRDS(results_list, results_list_file)
```

Plot top pathways enriched as a bar plot.
```{r}
#| label: plot_pathways_by_lobe_tumGenes
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false

# Read in pathway results
pathway_res <- readRDS(file = paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Data/pathwayEnrichmentResults_tumorGenes.rds"))

# Merge top enriched pathways
enrich_paths <- rbind(pathway_res$upper_genes@result,
                      pathway_res$lower_genes@result)
enrich_paths$direction <- c(rep("upper", nrow(pathway_res$upper_genes@result)),
                            rep("lower", nrow(pathway_res$lower_genes@result)))


# Filter data frame for p.adjust < 0.1
df_filtered <- enrich_paths %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.1)

# Add a column for bar length based on direction
df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
 mutate(bar_length = ifelse(direction == "upper", FoldEnrichment, -FoldEnrichment),
 color = ifelse(direction == "upper", -log10(p.adjust), -log10(p.adjust)))


# Arrange data frame by Fold Enrichment from highest to lowest
df_filtered <- df_filtered %>% arrange(desc(bar_length))


# Select top 5 in each direction by absolute bar length
df_top <- df_filtered %>%
  mutate(abs_length = abs(bar_length)) %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs_length, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Convert lobe terminology
df_top$direction <- gsub("lower", "Dense", df_top$direction)
df_top$direction <- gsub("upper", "Interdigitated", df_top$direction)


# Custom shorten a few pathway names for plotting
df_top$Description <- dplyr::recode(df_top$Description,
                                    "Modulation of host responses by IFN-stimulated genes" = "*Modulation by IFN",
                                    "Deposition of new CENPA-containing nucleosomes at the centromere" = "*Nucleosome deposition",
                                    "alpha-linolenic (omega3) and linoleic (omega6) acid metabolism" = "*ALA (omega3) and LA (omega6) metabolism")

# Create the plot
ggplot(df_top, aes(x = reorder(Description, bar_length), y = bar_length, fill = direction)) +
 geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
 scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dense" = "lightskyblue3", "Interdigitated" = "tomato3")) +
 coord_flip() +
 theme_minimal() +
 labs(y = "Fold Enrichment", x = "Pathway", fill = "Lobe") +
 theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
 axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
 axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
 axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
 legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
 legend.title = element_text(size = 20))
ggsave(filename = paste0(tumorDE_dir, "/Plots/barplot_pathwayEnrichmentByLobe_tumorGenes.png"),
       width = 12, height = 4, units = "in")
```
